notes: Self-declared tower defence, so Strategy, but the answers rule out an authored lane: walls placed anywhere reroute the enemies, who path dynamically across open ground. That is the genre's own no-track case, so the shape is terrain-open and the preset is Base Defense rather than Tower Defense — matching on what the preset builds, not on the word in the prompt — with buildzone-plot added for the free, proximity-gated ground the player mazes on, and destructible-cluster and cover-los dropped as nothing in the prompt asks for breakable terrain or pre-built sightline walls. Party & Casual is second for the hosting lobby: social-hub and teleporter-link cover the teleporters players use to host and enter a game. Decided without a user: built as one continuous map on P0 since whether a hosted match is a separate place is a scale judgement the prompt never settles (a split lobby/match pair would be P4 and is noted as deferrable), and the named mechs and guns become generic futuristic stand-ins per the answers, which is dressing rather than layout.
